title: What is on the display?
instruction: The rows of the 5 × 5 display from top to bottom (1 = on). Which picture do they encode?
debrief: Whoever knows the encoding rule can rebuild the same picture from the numbers. A number on its own means nothing.

pairs.why: One LED at the top, below it the arrow widens, and a shaft runs down.
Two eyes in the second row and a mouth that curves up into a smile at the bottom.
Two diagonals that meet in the middle.
Two arches at the top and a point at the bottom.
A vertical line, a gap and a dot.
